title: Baseball sign-stealing
hook: “I’m an Astros fan. They cheated during the 2017 regular season — the evidence is clear. In an attempt to understand the scope of the cheating and the players involved, I decided to listen to every pitch from the Astros’ 2017 home games and log any banging noise I could detect.” That’s from Tony Adams, who analyzed audio spectrograms corresponding to more than 8,200 pitches.
